description:
One case by document id or case number, with the cases related to it. Give
exactly one of `doc_id` or `cause_num`. Metadata only, no reasoning text: what
a court held comes from `get_document`.

Highest instance first, judgments before rulings, newest first.

`related_cases` is citation-graph overlap, never semantic similarity or a
judgement on merits, and may repeat a decision from `matches`. `score` weights
each shared anchor and case by rarity, so boilerplate ranks near nothing.
`departures`/`departed_by`: Supreme Court departures read from the texts.

cause_num.description: Case number. Cyrillic case variants all match.

match_limit.description: Max decisions per case to return (1-25).

max_chars.description: Cap on response characters; related-case evidence fits it.

related_limit.description: Max rows to return (0-200); 0 returns the count alone.

name: ua_edrsr__lookup_case
title: Look Up Court Case (EDRSR)
